## What result do you need?
Describe the problem and the output you want. This is a public issue: do not include customer records, private files, credentials, payment details, or personal contact information.

## Service
- [ ] CSV/JSON data repair or conversion (indicative starting price $49)
- [ ] MCP server verification (indicative starting price $99)
- [ ] Technical research and evidence brief (indicative starting price $79)

## Size and example
For data: approximate file size, row/column count, input/output format, and up to five requested transformation rules. Include only fictional rows or a non-sensitive schema.
For software: public repository/version, reproduction steps and expected behavior. Redact logs before sharing.
For research: one specific question and what decision the answer should support.

## Deadline and budget
Include your time zone. Leave the budget blank if you want a quote first.

## Acceptance criteria
How will you verify that the delivered result meets your needs?

## Before work begins
We confirm suitability, scope, fixed price, payment arrangements, turnaround and acceptance criteria in writing. Submitting this inquiry does not place an order or incur a charge. Services are AI-assisted under human oversight. Private materials require an agreed private transfer route. See [Services and pricing](https://github.com/JRCage/ribcage-agent-services/blob/main/SERVICES-AND-PRICING.md).
